searchText: is there something like https://github.com/ethereum/hive but for the PoS consensus layer? Anyone working on this? there is on-going work to extend hive to support both EL + CL clients thanks <@539495253418180618> . who is working on hive for CL, where can I find the people working on that? https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/481 https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/495 i'd start by reviewing the work here <@360491619402776577> is also working on EL mocker that will allow to test CL clients with respect to their behaviour around Engine API, the idea is EL mocker simulate a certain response on `newPayload/forkchoiceUpdated` and then CL client checked for expected state of the world, like head etc
